title: Sukhāya
text: 3 Tisso imā bhikkhave vedanā || katamā tisso || || Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā || || Imā kho bhikkhave tisso vedanā ti || || [page 205] XXXVI. 3. 6] PATHAMASAGĀTHAVAGGO 205 4 Sukhaṃ vā yadi vā dukkhaṃ || adukkhamasukhaṃ saha || Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca || Yaṃ kiñci atthi veditaṃ || || Etaṃ dukkhan ti ñatvāna || mosadhammam palokinaṃ || Phussaphussavayam passaṃ || evaṃ tattha virajjatīti || ||
